# Draft:Standard Metrics (software company)

}}
Quaestor Technologies, Inc., doing business as Standard Metrics, is a San Francisco, California-based technology company that specializes in VC and PE portfolio management software. The company focuses on facilitating financial data sharing between investors and their portfolio companies.
Standard Metrics was founded in 2020 by John Melas-Kyriazi, Kevin Hsu, Deny Khoung, and Joe Lonsdale.
History
Standard Metrics was founded as Quaestor Technologies, Inc. in 2020, after being incubated in the offices of 8VC. The company was launched as a solution for VCs to better understand their portfolio companies’ financial performances. Standard Metrics was created by John Melas-Kyriazi, a former VC at Spark Capital, Kevin Hsu, a product manager at cap table management startup Carta, Deny Khoung, head of operations at 8VC, and Joe Lonsdale, co-founder of Palantir Technologies, Addepar, OpenGov, and 8VC.
Quaestor Technologies, Inc. announced a $5.8M seed funding round in July 2020, led by 8VC with participation from Spark Capital, Abstract Ventures, Riot Ventures, Fathom Ventures and GFC.
Quaestor Technologies, Inc. simultaneously rebranded to Standard Metrics and announced a $23.7 million Series A, led by 8VC, in 2022. Other investors included Spark Capital, Alpha Edison, and January Capital, among other funds.
In September 2024, Standard Metrics added a second product beyond portfolio management — Global Benchmarking — for companies and firms to benchmark performance against and aggregated and anonymized data from participating companies on the platform.
In February 2025, the company announced a partnership with Derivatas, a venture capital valuation software and services company, to automate valuations workflows.
In May 2025, the company announced a partnership with Omni Analytics, a business intelligence platform, for easier analysis and visualizations of data within the Standard Metrics platform.
Products and services
Standard Metrics develops software to help VC and PE firms with portfolio management, assisting in portfolio company data requests, parsing, analysis, and reporting. Standard Metrics’ software also acts as a two-way network, automating investor reporting for portfolio companies.
Standard Metrics also offers a benchmarking tool that allows firms and their portfolio companies to compare performance against other anonymized startups across standardized financial performance benchmarks. These benchmarks can be segmented by size of company and industry.
Operations
Standard Metrics is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its customers include Bessemer Venture Partners, Accel, and Salesforce Ventures. John Melas-Kyriazi is the company's CEO.
